exposure: elements of the Geisinger Maternal Fetal Medicine obesity protocol (early diabetes screening, fetal monitoring, growth ultrasounds, delivery by EDD)
outcome: compliance with recommendation for delivery by estimated due date
cohort: The study included 97 obese pregnant patients whose charts were randomly selected for review.
finding: Compliance with the recommendation for delivery by estimated due date was excellent, but compliance with early diabetes screening, serial growth ultrasounds, and nonstress tests was low across different obesity classes.
